title: Stop Saying "Very Wet"! 3 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very wet". Use one of these words instead:
• Soaked: My shoes are soaked.
• Drenched: We got drenched in the rain.
• Soggy: The cereal got soggy.

Comment your own word for "very wet"!
